text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. These appointments are a result of the following public member's terms coming to an end: · Doug Lowry, term ending June 30, 2026 and until a successor is appointed. · Mona Eldardiry, term ending June 30, 2026, and until a successor is appointed. · Jasjit Sangha, term ending June 30, 2026, and until a successor is appointed. · Peggy Poon, term ending June 30, 2026, and until a successor is appointed. · Stephanie Donaldson, resigned effective November 28, 2022. · Nicholas Austin, resigned effective January 29, 2024. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-appointed the following individuals to the Scadding Court Community Centre Board, at pleasure of Council, for the term of office ending June 30, 2030, and until successors are appointed: - Alex Liang - Chartreuse Noutelie - Terrence Liu - Donna Alleyne - Alfred Adjetey Sowah - Coreen Gittens - Steve Lane 2. Appointed the following individuals to the Scadding Court Community Centre Board, at pleasure of Council, for the term of office ending June 30, 2030, and until successors are appointed: - Joan Williams - Sarah Bachinski - Alcia Aberdeen - Andy Din - Imani Abukar - Kenisha Peters
